description: Governors Office - Western Province - The Inquiry being Conducted under Section 184(1A) of the Urban Councils Ordinance read with Section 2 of the Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act No. 12 of 1989 - to Submit a report within 03 Months shall be extended until 30.09.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns a judicial/law enforcement matter - specifically the extension of an investigation period for a single person inquiry board comprised of a retired judge to investigate potential offenses by a local council and its chairman.
